mapper.sql: not exists (select 1 from wms_loc_attr ux where ux.node_id = s.node_id and ux.loc_usage in ('STAGING', 'QC')) and not exists ( with recursive up as ( select h.node_id, h.parent_id, 1 as lv from mst_equip_hier h where h.node_id = s.node_id union all select p.node_id, p.parent_id, u.lv + 1 from up u join mst_equip_hier p on p.node_id = u.parent_id where u.lv < 20 ) select 1 from up join wms_loc_attr x on x.node_id = up.node_id where x.loc_usage = 'SCRAP')

select h.plant_cd, h.ship_id, l.item_id, greatest(l.qty - coalesce((select sum(p.qty) from wms_ship_pick p where p.ship_line_id = l.ship_line_id and p.status in ('PICKED', 'SHIPPED')), 0), 0) as qty from wms_ship h join wms_ship_line l on l.ship_id = h.ship_id where h.status in ('DRAFT', 'PICKING')
(s.lot_id is null or not exists (select 1 from lot_master hx where hx.lot_id = s.lot_id and hx.hold_yn = 'Y'))
